title: Reserve Fund Assessment Returned on Cancellation — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Refund schedule entry on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) for the Reserve Fund Assessment of a cancelled policy, read from its Reserve Fund Assessment charges (new business, renewal and endorsement) and re-rate credits on the premium account.

**Rule.** The Reserve Fund Assessment a cancellation refund returns is settled as follows: when the reason refunds from inception, the Reserve Fund Assessment charges of the current term and the term before it are returned in full, less their re-rate credits; when the claim bar applies, nothing of the current term's Reserve Fund Assessment is returned; when the policy's latest Reserve Fund Assessment booked on an endorsement or its latest one credited on a re-rate belongs to the term in which the cancellation took effect, that term's Reserve Fund Assessment entries are returned the way their own occasions are, the term's other Reserve Fund Assessment charges for the days from the cancellation effective date to the end of that term over the days of the current term, that endorsement's charge for those days over the days from the endorsement's effective date to the end of that term, or in full when the endorsement took effect after the cancellation effective date, and that re-rate credit taken back for those days over the days from the certificate's effective date to the end of that term, or in full when the certificate took effect after the cancellation effective date, and the Reserve Fund Assessment charges of a term that began after the cancellation took effect are returned in full, less the re-rate credits booked on them; when the cancellation took effect before the current term start, the current term's Reserve Fund Assessment charges are returned in full, less the re-rate credits booked on them, and those of the term before it for the days from the cancellation effective date to the current term start over the days of the current term, or in full, less the re-rate credits booked on them, when the cancellation took effect on or before that term's start; otherwise the current term's Reserve Fund Assessment charges are returned for the days from the cancellation effective date to the term end over the days of the current term.

**Terms.** A reason refunds from inception when it is a duplicate NFIP policy or a loan closing that did not occur. The claim bar applies when the reason is one of mortgage paid off, voluntary — not required, replaced by private flood, and removed from the Special Flood Hazard Area by a Letter of Map Amendment or Revision, the cancellation took effect in the current term, and a loss dated on or after the current term start carries claim payments, net of the payment items voided, above zero, or the current term's return is held because the records cannot place such a paid loss on either side of the current term start, that is when no loss dated after the month band around the current term start carries such payments, a loss dated in that band does, and the latest loss on which a claim payment was ever issued is dated after the band, or is dated in the band on or after the current term start with its payments all voided, the month band being the losses dated as many whole calendar months before the processing date as the current term start is. The end of the term the cancellation took effect in is the term end for the current term and the current term start for the term before it; the days of a term are counted as the days of the current term.

## Ladder in order

1. Refunds from inception → current and preceding terms' charges in full, less their re-rate credits.
2. Claim bar applies → nothing of the current term.
3. Latest endorsement or re-rate entry belongs to the term the cancellation took effect in → each entry by its own occasion, as above; a later term's charges in full less its re-rate credits.
4. Cancellation took effect before the current term start → current term in full less its re-rate credits; preceding term pro rata to the current term start, or in full less its re-rate credits when on or before its start.
5. Otherwise → current term's charges for the days to the term end over the days of the current term.

## Case (hypothetical; 365-day term, in the current term)

Other charges 547.50, endorsement charge 36.00 effective with 180 days left, no re-rate, cancellation effective with 73 days left: 109.50 plus 14.60, which is 124.10.
